name: Freestanding tall structure
rules: Use a stable weighted base; secure against tipping; keep exit signs doors sprinklers and routes fully visible; obtain venue approval before attaching anything

name: Floor decoration cluster
rules: Place outside circulation and measured walkways; secure tall or top-heavy pieces; remove loose petals cables and small parts from walking surfaces

name: Temporary low-heat electric lighting
rules: Use low-heat LED products; inspect leads; protect and secure every cable; use the product only in its rated environment; do not obscure exits

name: Tabletop decor and service pieces
rules: Keep guest sightlines and service access open; keep unstable glass and small loose parts away from children; use battery LED candles instead of open flame near fabric

name: Welcome and directional signage
rules: Use readable text and a stable stand; never cover mandatory exit or safety signs; keep the sign and stand outside the required route
